title: Associate Territory Manager (ERO)
description:
**Job Title:** Associate Territory Manager**Function:** Commercial**Reports to:** Area Manager**Location:** Kolkata**Travel Required**:**25%****50%****þ****75%****About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**  


The Senior Business Development Executive/Associate Territory Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth within the assigned Area by effectively managing the sales process for all products, including Domestic Priority (DP), International, Retail, Cargo, and E\-Retail. The role will also focus on revenue enhancement through channel partners such as Regional Service Providers (RSPs), Consolidators, Franchise Collection Centres (FCCs), and One\-Stop Centres (OSCs). The incumbent will play a crucial role in customer acquisition, relationship management, and adherence to company sales policies.

**Job Purpose:**  


This role will focus on managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle, ensuring customer satisfaction, and driving sustained business development. It requires a highly motivated and target\-driven individual with a strong understanding of the logistics and courier industry.

 **Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**  

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**

* Monitor and drive Area revenue performance to achieve targeted sales growth and profitability.
* Evaluate the profitability of key accounts and take corrective measures to achieve profit targets.
* Track product\-wise yields regularly and develop action plans to meet set targets.
* Manage the end\-to\-end sales process for the Area, ensuring revenue growth for all products.

**Channel Partner \& Customer Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers, ensuring revenue retention.
* Identify and drive new business opportunities through channel partners.
* Monitor and enhance channel partner performance in terms of revenue, sales, and profitability.
* Support sales capability\-building initiatives for sales teams and channel partners.

**Sales Operations \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) among sales teams and channel partners.
* Implement sales and marketing strategies to enhance market share and profitability.
* Follow up and ensure closure of product\-specific sales leads received from telemarketing or other departments.
* Negotiate rates and service offerings with customers within set approval limits.
* Maintain and update prospect details in the Saffire system on a daily basis.
* Address and resolve customer service issues in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide insights to the Branch Sales Head regarding modifications to existing product offerings to enhance revenue and profitability.

**Collection \& Remittance**

* Ensure achievement of collection targets within the set remittance cycle and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) benchmarks.

**People Management**

* Guide and support the sales team to ensure high performance and goal alignment.
* Ensure optimal staffing levels within the Area sales team.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**  

**Education**:* Essential: Graduate degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Preferred: An MBA or Postgraduate degree in Sales \& Marketing.

**Experience**:

* 1\-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or key account management in the logistics, courier, supply chain, or e\-commerce industry.
* Experience in B2B sales, managing channel partners, and driving revenue growth is an added advantage

**Skills \& Capabilities:**  

**Technical Skills:*** Strong understanding of sales processes, revenue management, and market expansion strategies.
* Experience in logistics, courier services, or supply chain management.
* Proficiency in using sales tracking tools like Saffire and Avature.
* Knowledge of data analytics and business intelligence tools for tracking sales trends and performance.

**Key Competencies:*** Result\-Oriented: Strong drive to achieve sales targets and revenue growth.
* Customer\-Centric: Ability to develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Analytical Thinking: Proactive approach to market analysis and business development.
* Negotiation \& Influence: Strong persuasion skills to drive sales and revenue enhancement.

**Key Performance Indicators:**  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Growth in Area Revenues

  

% achievement of product\-wise and channel\-wise revenue targets


Achievement of yield targets (Yield per piece) for all products

  

Drive Market Growth

  

% increase in revenues from key industry segments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, etc.) and key accounts

  

Enhance Revenues via Channel Partners

  

Revenue targets achieved through RSPs and other channel partners

  

Ensure Timely Collections

  

Achievement of Logic Remittance targets


Reduction in outstanding receivables (e.g., 60\-day, 90\-day, 150\-day buckets)

  

Drive Sales Capability, Productivity, and Process Adherence

  

Achievement of Sales KPIs and compliance with SOPs

  

New Product Development

  

Successful implementation of new products in the Area

  

Foster a Performance\-Driven Culture

  

Timely adherence to Performance Management System guidelines

  

Drive Employee Morale and Engagement

  

Employee retention and engagement metrics

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

title: Market Access Manager
description:
Category: Market Access
Location:
Kolkata, West Bengal, IN
**Department**: Rare Disease \& Public Care

  

**Location**: Kolkata

  

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**

  

**Your impact begins here**

  

As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.

  

**What you'll bring**

  

* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

  

* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.

  

**What you'll do**

  

* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.
  

**Who you'll work with**

  

You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.

  

Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.

  

The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.

  

**What you can expect here**

  

You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.

  

You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.

  

**Start now**

  

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
**We're hiring: Performance Marketing Specialist**

Kolkata\| On\-site\| Full\-time

We are hiring a Performance Marketing Specialist who can turn advertising budgets into measurable, repeatable growth.

You will join **Solve Axis**, the group behind a growing portfolio of brands including **Solve LegalX, Solve GlobalX, OK Acquired, and Solve Desk**. Reporting to the founders and the CMO, you will help build and run the acquisition engine across the group.

The role calls for someone who can move across different customer segments, offers, and conversion journeys while keeping tight control over performance, research, reporting, and experimentation.

What you'll own

\- Google and Meta campaigns across the Solve Axis portfolio, end\-to\-end: planning, execution, optimization, and scaling.

\- A monthly advertising budget allocated across brands, channels, and audiences by performance and business priority.

\- Lead generation, remarketing, and customer acquisition campaigns across multiple business categories.

\- Campaign metrics, including CPL, CPA, CAC, conversion rate, and ROAS, translated into clear business decisions.

\- You need to have an understanding of how creative’s work in Meta and Google

\- Reporting that explains what changed why it changed, and what should be done next.

\- Market research in to customer problems, competitor offers, search intent, and audience behavior.

\- Structured testing across creative’s, hooks, formats, offers, messaging, audiences, and landing pages.

\- AI\-assisted workflows that sharpen research, analysis, reporting, ideation, and execution.

How you'll work

\- Work closely with the founders and CMO on strategy, priorities, budgets, and growth decisions.

\- Partner with design and content on creative’s, copy, messaging, offers, and campaign narratives.

\- Coordinate with the tech team on landing pages, tracking, analytics, and conversion improvements.

\- Translate campaign data into clear briefs and recommendations for these teams.

\- Keep campaigns, creative’s, landing pages, and tracking working together as one acquisition system.

What you need

\- 2–3\+years of hands\-on performance marketing experience.

\- Proven experience personally managing₹3\-4 lakh or more in monthly advertising spend.

\- Strong Google Ads and Meta Ads, particularly for lead generation and conversion campaigns.

\- Comfort working with GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, and attribution fundamentals.

\- Strong analytical and research ability: turning raw campaign data, competitor offers, and customer behavior into clear recommendations.

\- Good creative judgment and a feel for why a campaign or creative’s performing.

\- Practical experience using AI tools and AI\-assisted work flows in marketing.

\- The ability to run campaigns across multiple brands without losing attention to detail.

\- Strong communication, cross\-functional collaboration, and the ownership to move fast in a startup environment.

Why it's worth it

You will work across a house of brands while staying close to the founders, the CMO, and the actual business decisions. That means direct exposure to different categories, customer segments, funnels, and growth models, and real influence over strategy, creative, landing pages, tracking, reporting, and acquisition planning across the group.

To apply, send your résumé along with:

\- The monthly budgets you have personally managed, and the platforms and campaign types you have run.

\- Two or three campaigns you are proud of, including the objective, spend, CPL or CAC, conversion rate, and ROAS.

\- A brief explanation of what you changed to improve performance.

We prioritize real ownership, analytical thinking, collaboration, and measurable outcomes over polished CVs

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

**Job Summary**
---------------

As a Relationship Manager, you'll be responsible for managing and developing relationships with clients of International Banking to drive business growth and meet the bank's strategic objectives. You’ll help clients set wealth goals, manage investments, and create portfolios for long\-term growth and stability. You’ll be supported by specialists in the areas of investment, insurance, products and treasury to provide clients with comprehensive solutions.
  

This is an opportunity for you to demonstrate your relationship management, sales, customer service and communications skills. Our Relationship Managers can advance their careers across client segments or explore roles across Wealth and Retail Banking.


**About Wealth and Retail Banking**  

We service more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.


We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross\-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product propositions span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.


We’re investing USD $1\.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within Standard Chartered Group.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

• Support our clients to meet their financial needs, as they progress through their career and life\-stages.
  

• Build relationships for the long\-term and understand clients’ financial needs and aspirations to grow, manage and protect their wealth, with appropriate investment solutions.
  

• Stay ahead of the market and get regular market updates and investment insights from our Chief Investment Office (CIO) to share with clients.
  

• Leverage myWealth digital and help clients to create custom portfolios, check performance and asset allocation based on CIO’s advice.
  

• Provide outstanding client experiences.


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

• A minimum of 2 years of experience in client acquisition, relationship management and retail banking.
  

• Technical knowledge and expertise in consumer banking products (i.e. Treasury, Equities, Funds, Insurance, etc.).
  

• Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship building skills.
  

• Ability to learn new products and services quickly.
  

• Ability to work in a flexible and agile way.
  

• Self\-starters and team players who enjoy working in an international environment.
  

• Excellent local language skills, client networks and experience.
  

• Maintains a high standard of personal conduct and lives our valued behaviours.


**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.


Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.


Together we:


* **Do the right thing** and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* **Never settle,** continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* **Are better together,** we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
**What we offer**
-----------------

**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.


* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance,** with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time\-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* **Flexible working** options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* **Proactive wellbeing support** through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation,** one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Client Relationship Executive
description:
**Welfin** **is** ***Urgently Hiring Client Relationship Executives for our office located at Salt Lake Sector \-V, Kolkata.***

***Remuneration: Fixed Salary \+ TA\+ Incentives***

***CONTACT NO:\- 7439366153***

JOB DESCRIPTION: Client Relationship Executive

**Department:** Client Relationship / Sales \& Customer Service  
**Designation:** Client Relationship Executive  
**Reporting To:** Relationship Manager / Team Leader / Sales Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Kolkata, Salt Lake , Sector \- V

1\. Job Purpose

The Client Relationship Executive will be responsible for maintaining and strengthening relationships with existing and prospective clients, understanding their requirements, providing timely assistance, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction.

The incumbent will act as an important point of contact between the Company and its clients and will contribute towards client retention, business development, service quality, and achievement of organizational objectives.

2\. Key Responsibilities

**Client Relationship Management**

* Maintain regular communication with existing and prospective clients.
* Develop and maintain strong, professional, and long\-term relationships with clients.
* Understand client requirements, expectations, and concerns and ensure appropriate resolution.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with clients regarding services, requests, documentation, payments, and other matters.
* Ensure that clients receive timely and accurate information.

**Client Servicing \& Support**

* Respond promptly and professionally to client queries through telephone, email, meetings, or other approved communication channels.
* Understand client issues and coordinate with relevant internal departments for resolution.
* Track pending client requests and ensure timely closure.
* Keep clients informed about the status of their requests or concerns.
* Handle complaints professionally and escalate critical matters to the reporting manager wherever required.
* Maintain a high standard of client service and professionalism.

**Business Development**

* Identify potential business opportunities from existing and prospective clients.
* Understand client requirements and communicate relevant Company products/services.
* Support the Sales Team in generating new business opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling and up\-selling wherever applicable.
* Assist in client meetings, presentations, follow\-ups, and business proposals as required.
* Support the Company in achieving assigned business and revenue objectives.

**Client Retention**

* Maintain regular engagement with existing clients to strengthen relationships and improve retention.
* Monitor client satisfaction and identify potential issues that may affect the business relationship.
* Proactively address client concerns and coordinate internally for timely resolution.
* Gather client feedback and communicate relevant observations to the Management.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain updated records of client interactions, meetings, communications, complaints, requests, and follow\-ups.
* Update client information in the Company's CRM or other prescribed systems.
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports as required.
* Maintain proper documentation relating to assigned clients.
* Ensure confidentiality of client information and Company data.

3\. Key Result Areas (KRAs)

The employee's performance will primarily be evaluated on:

* Client satisfaction and service quality.
* Client retention and relationship management.
* Timely resolution of client queries and complaints.
* Response time and follow\-up effectiveness.
* Achievement of assigned business development targets, wherever applicable.
* Generation of leads and business opportunities.
* Cross\-selling and up\-selling performance, wherever applicable.
* Accuracy and timely updating of client records/CRM.
* Quality and timeliness of reporting.
* Compliance with Company policies and processes.

4\. Performance Parameters

The Company may prescribe specific performance parameters from time to time based on business requirements. These may include:

* Number of client interactions/follow\-ups.
* Client retention rate.
* Customer satisfaction levels.
* Query/complaint resolution time.
* Lead generation and conversion.
* Revenue/business generated from assigned clients.
* Client meeting and engagement targets.
* CRM/data accuracy.
* Timeliness of reporting and follow\-up.

Performance parameters may be revised by the Management based on business requirements and organizational objectives.

5\. Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication skills in Bengali, Hindi \& English and written communication in English.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Good customer service and client\-handling abilities.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good negotiation and persuasion skills.
* Ability to understand and respond to client requirements.
* Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.
* Professional telephone and email etiquette.
* Good time\-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to handle multiple clients and priorities simultaneously.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, CRM, email, and internet applications.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
* Positive, proactive, and customer\-oriented approach.

6\. Educational Qualification

* Minimum **Graduate** from a recognized university/institution.
* Candidates with qualifications in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Management, or related fields will be preferred.

7\. Experience

* **0–1 years** of experience in client relationship management, customer service, sales, business development, account management, or a related field.
* Candidates with relevant experience in handling corporate clients will be preferred.
* Candidates with strong communication and interpersonal skills may be considered based on their overall suitability.

8\. Salary \& Incentives

* Salary will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, skills, and suitability for the position.
* Performance\-based incentives may be applicable in accordance with the Company's prevailing incentive policy.
* Where applicable, incentives shall be linked to achievement of prescribed business and performance targets.

9\. Working Hours

The employee shall work according to the Company's prescribed working hours and business requirements.

The employee may be required to attend client meetings, make business visits, or work beyond normal working hours whenever reasonably required for client servicing or business requirements, subject to applicable Company policy and law.

10\. Probation

The selected candidate may be placed on probation for a period as specified in the offer letter.

During the probationary period, the employee's performance, client\-handling ability, communication skills, conduct, attendance, productivity, and achievement of assigned KRAs may be reviewed by the Management.

Confirmation of employment shall be subject to satisfactory performance and fulfillment of the Company's applicable policies and requirements.

11\. Reporting Structure

The Client Relationship Executive shall report to the **Relationship Manager / Team Leader / Sales Manager** or such other person as may be designated by the Management from time to time.

12\. General Responsibilities

The employee shall:

* Maintain professional conduct and discipline at all times.
* Follow all Company policies, procedures, processes, and instructions.
* Maintain confidentiality of client and Company information.
* Protect the Company's business interests and client relationships.
* Ensure appropriate and professional communication with clients.
* Maintain proper records and documentation.
* Coordinate effectively with internal departments.
* Use Company resources responsibly.
* Undertake additional responsibilities reasonably assigned by the Management from time to time.

***Remuneration: Fixed Salary \+ TA\+ Incentives***

***CONTACT NO:\- 7439366153***

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹17,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
